preconditions.description: The number of files n is between 1 and 500 inclusive.
There are exactly n distinct file names provided.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(name) <= 8 and name.islower() and name.isalpha() for name in file_names)
preconditions.description: Each file name is a string of 1 to 8 lowercase letters.

preconditions.expression: all(dep in file_names for deps in adjacency.values() for dep in deps)
preconditions.description: Every imported file name exists in the list of provided file names.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(deps)) == len(deps) for deps in adjacency.values())
preconditions.description: No file imports the same file more than once.

postconditions.description: If the dependency graph contains no cycles, the output is exactly 'SHIP IT'.

postconditions.expression: (not is_no_cycle) and (len(cycle_nodes) >= 1) and (all(cycle_nodes[i] in adjacency and cycle_nodes[(i+1) % len(cycle_nodes)] in adjacency[cycle_nodes[i]] for i in range(len(cycle_nodes))))
postconditions.description: If cycles exist, the output is a sequence of file names forming a valid cycle where each file imports the next, and the last imports the first.
The output cycle has the minimum possible length among all cycles in the graph.
The output format is either 'SHIP IT' or the space-separated names of the shortest cycle.
